senses.gloss:
ITA-1.8.2.24 vipakṣaḥ विपक्षः
Context in which a cause-and-effect relationship is negated
Figuratively, an adversarial context or environment.

ITA-4.5.11 viparītārthakārī विपरीतार्थकारी
Treatment with interventions known to be cause of disease

ITA-1.6.30 viparyayaḥ विपर्ययः
Implying the opposite meaning
A statement whose meaning suggests the opposite of its ostensible expression.

ITA-6.2.4.1 vipākaḥ विपाकः
Post digestive state
Taste of a substance after undergoing complete digestion and transformation. There are three types: sweet, sour and astringent.

ITA-5.59.12 vipādikā विपादिका
Cracks in palms and soles
A skin disease characterized by cracks in the skin of hands and feet; severe pain; less itching; redness/congestion; associated with eruptions.

ITA-4.4.24 viprakṛṣṭahetuḥ विप्रकृष्टहेतुः
Distant etiological factor
A distant or indirect causative factor which is less influential in giving rise to a disease or condition.
